problem: The only known autonomous self-correction (PHASE-945's Goal<->Capability contradiction detector catching 942's overapplication error, corrected at 946) was a one-time script execution never re-armed; later avoidance of the same error class depended entirely on an agent manually retrieving and applying the historical lesson, with no structural guarantee it would happen again.

decision.decision_summary: Reuse detectGoalCapabilityContradictions() verbatim (extracted via the same AST/VM technique readCaptureState() already uses, never duplicated, never modifying the original PHASE-945 file) as a synchronous, zero-threshold, 5-goal structural check. No contradiction leaves the existing flow fully unaffected. A contradiction triggers targeted capability_ref retrieval, filtered to real corrects_experience_id links only, followed by an independent exact-key re-verification of the corrected Experience and evidence/SHA resolution of its real original evidence. No status is ever auto-modified; the guard only forces correction memory to be read and verified before a judgment proceeds.

action.action_summary: Added services/genieGoalCapabilityCorrectionRearm.mjs and its verifier. Ran the real detector plus the real live 117-record canonical Experience store against a throwaway fixture recreating the exact 942 condition (positive control), against the real current repository state (normal-state negative control), and against a fixture recreating a contradiction for a capability with no real correction (unrelated-correction negative control). Ran all pre-existing GENIE regressions.

evidence.evidence_detail: Positive control: recreated 942 condition -> exp_phase946_semantic_quality_capability_correction_01 found, corrects_experience_id exp_phase942_... re-verified via exact-key lookup, original evidence resolved with sha256 18ca34ba022e60af3d3c3326483fca59972d25a88837212b6db7905eac87a8db. Normal-state negative: real live data shows contradiction_detected:false today. Unrelated-correction negative: contradiction for cap_production_runtime correctly yields forced_reads:[] (no hallucinated correction). 11/11 pre-existing GENIE regressions plus 5 new fixture checks passed. Original PHASE-945 source file unmodified (mtime and git status confirmed).

cause.root_cause_summary: The original PHASE-945 detector was a one-off phase-materialization script, never re-invoked after its single run, so nothing structurally re-checked whether the same Goal<->Capability contradiction shape could recur; its own general-purpose detection logic was real and reusable but simply never wired to fire again.

lesson: A one-time autonomous detector does not need to be reinvented to be re-armed -- extracting its exact existing logic (via the same side-effect-free AST/VM technique already used elsewhere in this codebase) and wiring it to the existing targeted retrieval and evidence/SHA chain closes the durability gap with zero new detection logic, zero full-memory scanning, and zero arbitrary thresholds.
